verdict.rationale: AgentMail's evidence shows event-delivery primitives, such as webhooks and WebSockets for inbound email, that a developer can use to build their own background agent. However, it documents no first-party automation feature, such as rules, scheduled jobs or a hosted runner, that executes autonomously in the background. Workflow automation via Sim or other frameworks is a third-party integration, not AgentMail's own capability, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
